sn45.5:1.2: Then a number of bhikkhus approached the Blessed One…. Sitting to one side, those bhikkhus said to the Blessed One:
sn45.5:2.1: “Here, venerable sir, wanderers of other sects ask us:
sn45.5:2.2: ‘For what purpose, friends, is the holy life lived under the ascetic Gotama?’
sn45.5:2.3: When we are asked thus, venerable sir, we answer those wanderers thus:
sn45.5:2.4: ‘It is, friends, for the full understanding of suffering that the holy life is lived under the Blessed One.’
sn45.5:2.5: We hope, venerable sir, that when we answer thus we state what has been said by the Blessed One and do not misrepresent him with what is contrary to fact; that we explain in accordance with the Dhamma, and that no reasonable consequence of our assertion gives ground for criticism.”
sn45.5:3.1: “Surely, bhikkhus, when you answer thus you state what has been said by me and do not misrepresent me with what is contrary to fact; you explain in accordance with the Dhamma, and no reasonable consequence of your assertion gives ground for criticism.
sn45.5:3.2: For, bhikkhus, it is for the full understanding of suffering that the holy life is lived under me.
sn45.5:3.3: “If, bhikkhus, wanderers of other sects ask you:
sn45.5:3.4: ‘But, friends, is there a path, is there a way for the full understanding of this suffering? ’—being asked thus, you should answer them thus:
sn45.5:3.5: ‘There is a path, friends, there is a way for the full understanding of this suffering.’
sn45.5:4.1: “And what, bhikkhus, is that path, what is that way for the full understanding of this suffering?
sn45.5:4.2: It is this Noble Eightfold Path; that is,
sn45.5:4.4: This is the path, this is the way for the full understanding of this suffering.
sn45.5:4.5: “Being asked thus, bhikkhus, you should answer those wanderers of other sects in such a way.”
